pairs.description: Ashwagandha enhances central nervous system depression when combined with benzodiazepines, z-drugs, or barbiturates.
pairs.mechanism: GABA-mimetic activity of withanolides augmenting central inhibitory neurotransmission.

pairs.description: Ashwagandha stimulates thyroid hormone production and can increase serum T3 and T4 levels, potentially causing thyrotoxicosis with levothyroxine.
pairs.mechanism: Direct stimulation of thyroid follicular gland synthesis and release of thyroxine.

pairs.description: Ashwagandha exhibits immunostimulant activity which can counteract the therapeutic efficacy of immunosuppressive agents.
pairs.mechanism: Proliferation of immune cells and stimulation of pro-inflammatory cytokines opposing immunosuppressant drugs.
